patch_resolves_note: The official patch.diff does not apply to the staged vulnerable checkout, so the fixed-side oracle is the authoritative n132/arvo:42485333-fix image. On the stock PoC that image reaches zone_check with zone_id_prefix_valid=0, never reaches host_emit, and exits clean; on the closest tried witness that actually exercises the protected event (CASE double_colon_one_pct25_zone0, input Y://[::1%250]) it reaches host_emit with zone_id_prefix_valid=1 and still exits clean.

nodes.description: First project-side input consumption on the crashing path that creates vulnerability-relevant state: `uri_cleanup()` rewrites the attacker's literal space inside the bracketed host into `%20`, introducing the `%` later treated as a zone-ID delimiter.

The vulnerable scope-ID handling treats the first `%` as a temporary terminator and validates only the truncated prefix. The later block at lines 416-423 then restores the suffix with only secondary `%` and `%25` checks instead of parsing and decoding a ZoneID.
ASan crash site. During URI reserialization, `g_string_insert_len()` performs the witnessed 5-byte read from data derived from the `parse_host()` heap buffer.
At the final UTF-8 branch, _uri_encoder() asks to append len=g_utf8_skip[*p] bytes from the trailing host byte even though only end - p bytes remain in the source span.
